parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud account.

parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:

*   qcloud: Tencent Cloud
*   aliyun: Alibaba Cloud
*   hcloud: Huawei Cloud

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the data source. The ID is an MD5 hash value that is calculated by the threat analysis feature based on specific parameters. You can call the [DescribeDataSourceInstance](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CDescribeDataSourceInstance) operation to query the IDs of data sources.

parameters.name: DataSourceInstanceLogs
parameters.description: The parameters of the data source. Set this parameter to a JSON string.

parameters.name: DataSourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS)
*   wafApi: download API of Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF)
*   ckafka: Tencent Cloud Kafka (CKafka)

parameters.name: LogInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the log. The ID is an MD5 hash value that is calculated by the threat analysis feature based on specific parameters. You can call the [ListDataSourceLogs](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListDataSourceLogs) to query log IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the data management center of the threat analysis feature resides. Specify this parameter based on the regions in which your assets reside. Valid values:

*   cn-hangzhou: Your assets reside in regions in China.
*   ap-southeast-1: Your assets reside in regions outside China.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem modify-data-source-log --log-code cloud_siem_waf_xxxxx --account-id 123xxxxxxx --data-source-type obs --data-source-instance-id ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --data-source-instance-logs LogCode_:_cloud_siem_qcloud_waf_alert_log_,_LogParas_:_ParaCode_:_api_name_,_ParaValue_:_GetAttackDownloadRecords --log-instance-id ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem ModifyDataSourceLog --region cn-hangzhou --DataSourceInstanceLogs 'LogCode_:_cloud_siem_qcloud_waf_alert_log_,_LogParas_:_ParaCode_:_api_name_,_ParaValue_:_GetAttackDownloadRecords' --CloudCode hcloud --LogInstanceId ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --AccountId 123xxxxxxx --DataSourceType obs --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LogCode cloud_siem_waf_xxxxx --DataSourceInstanceId ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1
